quote.text: The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.
quote.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein, Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus, proposition 5.6, 1921

stories.headline: Anthropic’s S-1 names $637bn of compute deals and leaves the total blank
stories.dek: Broadcom alone is $161.2bn of five-year equipment leases, Google $114.5bn and SpaceX up to $120.5bn at about $3.1bn a month from December — while the summary line still reads “more than $ ”.

stories.headline: Ivor Bagley won the 2026 Rosebowl with a Dalí cut from wood veneer
stories.dek: The Marquetry Society has run its exhibition since 1952 and ranks entrants in ten classes; take its top trophy and you are promoted to Premier and made a Fellow, permanently.

stories.headline: Pakistan’s Buraq promises an Urdu model its own state never wrote in
stories.dek: Shaza Fatima Khawaja announced a sovereign Urdu large language model in Seoul on 22 October. Urdu is 0.0315 per cent of the crawlable web, and the largest corpus ever assembled in it runs to 1.84 billion tokens.

stories.headline: Renfe’s AVE hit a stopped Iryo train near Toledo; at least 68 died
stories.dek: Spain’s transport minister says Adif’s control centre cleared six halted trains to resume after an eight-minute signalling failure, capping them at 40km/h — and the AVE was doing about 200.

stories.headline: Shanmugam summons ten firms as Singapore arms the NEA with haze assessors
stories.dek: Shanmugam told leaders of ten Singapore-registered companies on Wednesday that Section 10 notices are “not routine requests”; the amendments reach Parliament on 3 November, and the firms will pay for the assessors.

stories.headline: Jiecang builds the base under a $599 Uplift and a $2,349 Jarvis alike
stories.dek: The Chinese actuator house also bought Austria’s Logicdata for €79.18m in 2021 — and Linak’s own data sheet rates a desk column for two minutes of movement in every twenty.

stories.headline: Sigma ships the 376g fp2 on 11 November at $2,199, still without IBIS
stories.dek: Richard Butler of DPReview notes the partially stacked sensor still syncs flash at 1/50sec; the local distributor is already running the hero banner, with no Singapore price behind it.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Unmeasured Flagship
stories.headline: Audio-Technica’s ATH-AWX7000 sells at $3,799 with no published measurement
stories.dek: Three reviews landed between 23 and 28 October and all are listening notes; Major HiFi states it outright — “Measurements: None” — and the Kiso cypress flagship has no Singapore price or stockist.

stories.headline: Warner Bros. opened Clayface at number one with $24.0m from 3,458 theatres
stories.dek: Critics gave the body-horror Batman spin-off a Metascore of 59 from 45 reviews; the 2,500 verified viewers behind its 94 per cent Popcornmeter disagreed by 35 points.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Phone Ban Evidence
stories.headline: Iceland banned phones in 22 schools and JAMA found no mental-health gain
stories.dek: Across 23,938 adolescents and seven outcomes, not one result cleared the study’s own threshold — and Singapore widened its own ban to recess and CCAs in January.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The October Hold
stories.headline: The Fed held at 3.75 per cent; Cook and Hammack both voted to hike
stories.dek: Kevin Warsh’s committee split ten to two the day before the September inflation print it says it is waiting for — and the market moved to an 82.6 per cent chance of a December rise.

stories.headline: Whitehall II finds a wrist accelerometer predicts death no better than a stopwatch
stories.dek: Across 4,067 people in the Whitehall II cohort and 739 deaths over a median 11.8 years, nine days of sensed walking cadence scored 0.744 against 0.747 for a nurse timing a 2.44-metre walk.

stories.headline: Gardens by the Bay opens The Story of Studio Ghibli on 18 December
stories.dek: Tickets are live at S$39 for residents with children aged 3 to 12 at S$29 — and ART SG’s two-for-one early bird closes at 11.59pm on 24 November.
